data.one_liner: Retrieves mobile and Wi-Fi internet signal strength in dBm on Android.
data.what_it_does: A Flutter plugin for Android that gets mobile and Wi-Fi signal information, returning the RSSI value in dBm along with additional Wi-Fi details like link speed, frequency, SSID, and BSSID.
use_when: You need to measure cellular or Wi-Fi signal strength in dBm within an Android app.
You want to retrieve Wi-Fi connection info like SSID, frequency, and link speed.
avoid_when: You need cross-platform support including iOS (iOS is currently in development).
You are looking for general device network connectivity status changes rather than specific signal strength metrics.
strengths: Provides precise signal strength values in dBm.
Combines mobile and Wi-Fi data retrieval into a single plugin.
weaknesses: Android-only support currently; iOS is not yet supported.
Requires explicit Android permissions and location services enabled for certain Wi-Fi metadata due to system privacy restrictions.
data.setup_notes: Requires setting the minimum Android SDK to 21 or higher and adding permissions like ACCESS_FINE_LOCATION, READ_PHONE_STATE, ACCESS_WIFI_STATE, and ACCESS_NETWORK_STATE to the Android manifest.

alternatives.name: connectivity_plus
alternatives.why_pick_it: Choose this if you need cross-platform connectivity type monitoring (Wi-Fi, cellular, ethernet) across Android, iOS, and other platforms without detailed signal dBm measurements.
